purpose: Freeze the machine-readable output future Godot T12 parity tests must emit so results can be compared against ENGINE_TEST_VECTORS.json and the non-shipping reference oracle.

field_contracts.candidate_source: exact activated T12 candidate commit SHA; non-empty and never a prepared governance commit when used for acceptance
field_contracts.vector_id: must resolve exactly once to ENGINE_TEST_VECTORS.json
field_contracts.eligible_level_ids: must exactly match reference expected ordering
field_contracts.new_one_time_event_ids: must exactly match reference expected ordering
field_contracts.state_hash_before: deterministic hash of query input/component state before the pure query
field_contracts.state_hash_after: must equal state_hash_before for pure eligibility/query evaluation
field_contracts.repeat_output_hashes: at least two hashes from identical repeated queries; all values must be identical

acceptance_rules: Every prepared vector must have exactly one engine result and no unknown vector may appear.
Engine eligible_level_ids and new_one_time_event_ids must exactly match the frozen reference vector expected output.
state_hash_before must equal state_hash_after for every pure query vector.
repeat_output_hashes must contain at least two identical non-empty hashes for every vector.
This parity evidence cannot replace T10/T11 binding proof, shipping integration tests, C6, device evidence or independent critics.
